method.expected_winner_rule: For an exact equal loadout, the swapped invocation replays the same team inputs; winner must stay the same team index.
method.old_phase1_assertion_error: The earlier probe expected 1-winner for garden-versus-garden. That rule is for distinct teams and incorrectly classified all 100 identity replays as failures.
method.fair_coin_rule: Equal deployment keys consume one randrange(2) before deployment. The diagnostic gates replay invariance and reports the observed first-team count/binomial summary; it does not claim to prove long-run fairness from 100 seeds.
method.distinct_team_rule: Distinct teams continue to require winner inversion and 180-degree rotated side fingerprints.

limits: A 55/45 or similar finite outcome split is not itself evidence of bias.
Exact event replay is the hard invariant; the binomial p-value is descriptive.
